title: 2026英二真题·儿童户外活动(静态柱状图·段落库首练)
comment: 段落库三件套(批2+批6+批8)首次成文, 打字提交。内容档13(数据4/4全对/排序正确/双高合并处理正确/三段完整), 语言档8(children's所有格×3错+漏冠词+33.2漏%+framework词背串prefer. alternatives+第三段宾语错位quality education), 结构档12-13, 综合11/15(10-12档)。第二段开头句重复出现两遍按粘贴手滑剔除。修所有格+框架词稳上12-13。
issues: children's所有格反复丢(childens/children outdoor共4处)——题眼词当整体词组默写
框架词背串: provide deliberate guidance写成prefer. alternatives; holds a share丢冠词
槽位词张冠李戴: 槽B quality education塞进第三段Schools句宾语(全篇唯一离题句), 第二段S3意识加深句漏写
数据表达: 33.2漏%号(数据本身全对)
essay:
This bar chart offers a clear visualization of how childens'outdoor activity is distributed across various everyday choices. As for satisfying the curiosity, it takes the largest share at 54.6%, followed by fostering the observation which holds share of 54.5%. In contrast, building the body up and improving parent-child interaction have a much smaller portion, at 37.2% and 33.2%. Together, these figures illustrate the growing influence of children outdoor activities in modern life.

Placed in the context of everyday life, the formation of children outdoor activities is propelled by the combined influence of multiple factors. As real life continues to develop, people's expectations for their children's all-round growth no longer remain at the level of superficial satisfaction, which has undoubtedly laid a more solid foundation for children's activity.

We need to think rationally about the impact of children's activity on the present era, and provide prefer. alternatives. Government should clarify relevant strategies, so that children's growth can better adapt to the development of today's society. Schools and media need to carry out targeted education and guidance, enabling the public to gain a deep understanding of quality education. Notably, parents should maintain a rational mindset when considering the impact of children's growth on today's society.

title: 2010英二真题·动态图模板套用(手机订阅量)
comment: 功能句动态三段模板首练。审题准(动态图/对象/时间/单位全对)、数据无编造、结构清晰、无语法硬伤; 扣分集中在评论泛化——归因未挂钩'发展中国家暴涨vs发达国家趋平'这一核心对比, 加尾段两句同义重复, 属'蓝字没换透'典型样本。按批改指令四节直批(会话内, 不走GLM)。
issues: 描述漏掉图上关键对比: 发展中国家约2004年反超发达国家未点出
P2归因万能套话, 加 especially in developing countries 才能焊在图上
P3第3句与第1句语义重复(today's society复现), 应换成具体行为建议
essay:
This bar chart presented the temporal changes of mobile-phone subscriptions and revealed a clear pattern of development over time. From 2000 to 2008, the number in developing countries rose from about 0.25 billion to 4 billion. During the same period, the subscriptions in developed countries increased from 0.6 billion to 1 billion, with the growth leveling off in the later years. Taken together, these trends outlined the overall trajectory of global mobile communication and underscored its changing influence in modern society.

Placed in the context of everyday life, the mobile-phone boom is propelled by the combined influence of multiple factors. The continuous growth of national economic strength has undoubtedly laid a solid foundation for the emergence of this trend. In addition, with the increase in citizens' wealth and the expansion of available choices, mobile phones have become increasingly popular. Equally important, people today are more inclined to pursue a convenient and connected life, which has gradually enabled the mobile phone to become integrated into everyday life.

We need to think rationally about the impact of the mobile-phone boom on the present era, and provide deliberate guidance. Government should clarify relevant strategies, so that mobile communication can better adapt to the development of today's society. Notably, individuals should maintain a rational mindset when considering the impact of mobile phones on today's society.
